questions.question: Use a number line to explain why 40 − 65 = −25 and −25 + 30 = 5.
questions.expected_answer: From 40 move 65 left: 40 steps to 0 and 25 more to −25. From −25 move 30 right: 25 steps to 0 and 5 more to 5.

questions.question: Explain why 3 − (−4) = 7, using a real-life example.
questions.expected_answer: Removing a debt or wrong R4 charge (−4) from an account with R3 increases the balance by R4, so 3 − (−4) = 3 + 4 = 7. Subtracting an integer is adding its opposite.
